description: holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/ holds about 3,435 KB-failure-*.json files. Around 2,900 are single-flow review chatter: every ledger ref of the file is an ACT-REV or ACT-FIND row (the review and finding rows) written by one flow, i.e. one intent root (the I-<id>-<slug> in payload.name; 225 distinct names, the largest holds 113 files). Promotion of such chatter already stopped (the review-chatter guard in the failure promotion code), but the committed files remain and CI make lint-json (jq over every JSON file) scans every one of them.
goal: A new script scripts/prune_kb_single_flow_failures.py (dry run by default, --apply to delete) lists every holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/KB-failure-*.json whose evidence.ledger_refs resolve only to ACT-REV or ACT-FIND rows of a single intent root, and with --apply deletes exactly those files; any file backed by two or more distinct intent roots, or by any other row kind (ACT, ACT-RES, ACT-GATE, ACT-WITHDRAW, ACT-CAL, ACT-BUDGET, REV-*, E-*), is kept. The script is run once with --apply on the tree so the single-flow files are removed in this change. make lint-json and the knowledge index still pass after the deletion, and nothing under holon-knowledge/kb/patterns or holon-knowledge/wisdom changes. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script; the new script stays within the default budget.
rationale: About 85 percent of the failure-mode files are one flow's own review rows. Deleting them shortens lint-json and every knowledge-index load without losing cross-flow recurrence evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The script defaults to a dry run that prints the count and deletes nothing; --apply deletes only files classified as single-flow chatter.

Tests on small fixture trees cover: a file with only ACT-REV refs of one intent root is pruned; a file with ACT-FIND refs of two intent roots is kept; a file with any other ref kind is kept; the dry run deletes nothing.
After the change the count of KB-failure-*.json files fell by the number the dry run reported on main, and every kept file is byte-identical to main.
make lint-json passes and the knowledge index builds.
No source file outside the scope list changes; the module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched.
